Karnataka High Court: Failure to report sexual assault is a crime

The Karnataka High Court has refused to quash a case against the co-founder of an education app, stating that failing to report sexual assault is itself a crime. The court described the alleged actions as 'glaring acts'. This ruling clarifies legal responsibilities regarding the reporting of sexual offenses.
